verdict.rationale: Deepgram explicitly documents a 'multilingual voice agent' concept, noting that STT and TTS model choices determine language behavior (deepgram-docs-10), which implies multi-language conversational support. However, no evidence explicitly confirms automatic mid-call language detection or dynamic switching between languages during a single conversation—the docs only outline model configuration, not live switching behavior. missing for 10: explicit documentation or example of automatic language detection, mid-call language switching mechanics, and confirmation of supported language pairs during live calls.
